entries.name: ARD-201
entries.stage: Phase 2 POWER initiated, then voluntarily paused; STRENGTH planned, then paused
entries.summary: Aardvark describes ARD-201 as a planned once-daily oral fixed-dose combination of ARD-101 and a DPP-4 inhibitor. Its August 2026 SEC filing says POWER began in December 2025 to study prevention of weight regain after more than 15% GLP-1-receptor-agonist-associated weight loss. STRENGTH was planned to study weight loss, including ARD-201 alone and with GLP-1 therapy. Both programmes were voluntarily paused on 27 February 2026.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation or a UK clinical-trial authorisation for ARD-201. A US Phase 2 start is not marketing approval.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed sources.
entries.supply: A paused investigational programme does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock, expanded access or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The FDA clinical hold described in the filing applies to the ARD-101 IND; ARD-201 contains ARD-101, so Aardvark says further ARD-201 timing depends on resolving that hold and future regulatory discussions. The pause followed reversible cardiac observations in a healthy-volunteer ARD-101 study. This entry does not infer causation, severity, a restart, termination or a timetable. No POWER or STRENGTH results, weight-maintenance benefit, weight-loss benefit, lean-mass benefit, safety, superiority or approved regimen is established. The still-live sponsor programme page describes planned trials but does not supersede the later SEC status disclosure.
